') as concatreqid,fn.rn FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON(a.room_no,a.req_id) room_no as rn,c.date_range,b.name,(CASE WHEN a.type='R' THEN (CASE WHEN c.nor_req>'1' THEN CONCAT(c.nor_req,' ','Rooms') ELSE '1 Room' END) ELSE (CASE WHEN c.nod_g_req>'1' THEN CONCAT(c.nod_g_req,' ','Beds') ELSE '1 Bed' END) END) AS type FROM tr_allotment a LEFT JOIN (SELECT STRING_AGG(name,',') as name,req_id FROM guest_details GROUP BY req_id) b ON b.req_id=a.req_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT STRING_AGG(CONCAT('(',TO_CHAR(from_date, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI'), ' - ', TO_CHAR(to_date, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI'),')'), ', ') AS date_range,req_id,nor_req,nod_g_req FROM gad_request GROUP BY req_id) c on c.req_id=a.req_id WHERE a.status IN ('ALO', 'PRO') AND ((a.from_date::date>=now()::date)) AND rd.room_no = a.room_no AND rd.block_id =a.block_id ORDER BY a.req_id,a.room_no,a.from_date ASC) as fn GROUP BY fn.rn) as fnex on true LEFT JOIN (SELECT gh_id,gh_name FROM gh_details) as gh on gh.gh_id=rd.gh_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT block_name,block_id FROM room_block) as bl on bl.block_id=rd.block_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT reason,room_no FROM m_repair_block) as rb on rb.room_no=rd.room_no WHERE rd.block_id=? and rd.gh_id=? order by rd.room_no

select distinct(b.req_id),a.balance,a.bill_id,f.rec_id,c.from_date,c.to_date,c.mobile_no,rb.block_name,gd.gh_name, d.name,e.onlyname,f.date_rece,g.date,c.category_type,g.billno,pi.item_title,q.category,COALESCE(c.no_of_adults,0) + COALESCE(c.no_of_children,0) as no_of_guest ,rb.address as gh_address,rb.contact_num,rb.mail_id as gh_mail,c.email_id,c.address,c.mobile_no, ta.room_no from tr_dues a JOIN tr_billvsguest b on a.bill_id = b.bill_id JOIN gad_request c on c.req_id = b.req_id JOIN room_block rb on c.block_id = rb.block_id JOIN gh_details gd on c.gh_id = gd.gh_id JOIN (SELECT req_id, STRING_AGG((SELECT CONCAT(name, CASE WHEN designation <> '' THEN CONCAT(',', designation) ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN department <> '' THEN CONCAT(',', department) ELSE '' END)), ' & ' ORDER BY guest_id) AS name FROM guest_details GROUP BY req_id) AS d ON c.req_id = d.req_id JOIN (SELECT req_id, STRING_AGG(name, ', ') AS onlyname FROM guest_details GROUP BY req_id) AS e ON c.req_id = e.req_id JOIN (SELECT req_id, checkin_date, checkout_date, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT (SELECT CONCAT(room_no, CASE WHEN bed_no IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('-', bed_no) END )), ',') AS room_no FROM tr_allotment WHERE status = 'COUT' GROUP BY req_id, checkin_date, checkout_date) ta ON c.req_id = ta.req_id JOIN tr_receipt f on a.rec_id = f.rec_id JOIN tr_bill_master g on a.bill_id = g.bill_id JOIN quota q ON q.quota_type = c.category_type JOIN public.m_purpose_items pi on c.purpose = pi.item_id where c.req_id= ?
